newsitem.title: USA: Fifth Third files for $200 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Third files for $200 mln shelf.

text.p: Two business trusts formed by Fifth Third Bancorp filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in preferred securities.

The trusts, known as Capital Trust I and Capital Trust II, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of Fifth Third Bancorp, the filing said.
The corporation said it intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the debentures for general corporate purposes.
Fifth Third, based in Cincinnati, Ohio, is a multi-bank holding company with about $21 billion in total consolidated assets as of December 31, 1996.
